Chris Pollitt has led laughter yoga sessions and workshops in Metro Vancouver for nearly two decades. After a background in technology, he became a certified Laughter Yoga Leader and Career Development Practitioner in 2009. More: https://universal-laughter.com/about
Chris works with organizations of all sizes:
• Laughter Yoga Session (the most popular): fun laughter games that get any group laughing.
• Games for Team Building: high-energy "tag" games such as human foosball, fox and squirrel and tunnel tag.
• Interpersonal Communication Workshop: the "4 Level Connection" technique, a blend of Nonviolent Communication and Imago Dialogue.
• Career Development Workshops: explore your strengths, values and skills to find a career that fits.
Details: https://universal-laughter.com/services
A typical Laughter Yoga session is 60 minutes, team-building games 30 to 60 minutes, and the communication workshop 1 to 2 hours. Duration and fee are flexible.
Universal Laughter is based in Vancouver, BC and works across Metro Vancouver.
